title: Bag of Bricks - Red 26
descriptionHtml:
Red — colour 26

Bold, primary and impossible to ignore. Red is the colour for hearts, logos, sports kits and any point in a design where you want the eye to land first.

Works well with: Dark Red 25, Bright Orange 35, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Red bricks (colour 26) for Memobrick mosaics. A bold primary red for hearts, logos and anywhere you need the eye to land first.
